title: सामा चकेवाको कथा
caption:
A false accusation turned Krishna's daughter into a bird. Her brother's love brought her back.

The legend of Sama Chakeva: Krishna's daughter Sama is falsely accused and turned into a bird by her father as punishment. Her brother's love and sacrifice restore her.
A folk tale celebrated across Mithila, in Nepal and India, from the night of Chhath until Kartik Purnima.

झुटो आरोपले कृष्णकी छोरीलाई चरा बनायो, भाइको मायाले फेरि मानिस बनायो।

Would you stay beside someone wrongly blamed, or fight to set them free?
Send this to the sibling who would do anything for you.

title: ताज की पहली कहानी
caption:
A hotel door was shut on Jamsetji Tata. Or so the legend says. Was it really why the Taj began?

The legend of Jamsetji Tata and the Taj Mahal Palace in Bombay (Mumbai), India. One telling says he was turned away from Watson's Hotel, then built the Taj at Colaba, opened in 1903. Historians are not sure it happened.

हिंदी में: बंद दरवाज़े का जवाब, एक शानदार होटल।

Would you knock harder, or build a bigger house?

title: The Gift of the Magi
caption:
She sold her hair. He sold his watch. Both wanted the perfect Christmas gift.

A poor young couple, one Christmas Eve, and two gifts neither can use.
A classic O. Henry short story about love and sacrifice.

Adapted from "The Gift of the Magi" by O. Henry (1905).

What is the most precious thing you would give up for someone you love?
